materializerDynamicProjection.rootCause: DockerTransformer stores imageUuid/environment/ports/logConfig in InstanceRecord data.fields; the five-argument WrappedResource constructor did not receive that dynamic value map, so the real role-schema projection omitted required business values.
materializerDynamicProjection.fix: Pass a fresh LinkedHashMap copy of DataUtils.getFields(instance) to the seven-argument WrappedResource constructor. Keep the existing current-role SchemaFactory, ID formatter, POST and createResponse=false behavior.
preservedBusinessValues: environment exact scalar including embedded equals
materializerDynamicProjection.visibilityBoundary: Current native role schema remains authoritative. Hidden environment, read-on-create-only ports/logConfig and unlisted dynamic fields remain absent; no role or Key authority expansion, raw bypass or new environment-input channel.

nativeActionOperandLockOrder.rootCause: Outer native API write transaction retained a prefetch row lock after application-lock release; concurrent receipt GET inverted lock order.
nativeActionOperandLockOrder.fix: Native Catalog-launch, resource-change and upgrade action operands use only exact framework request markers and authorized read snapshots. No prefetch observation writes or retained plan/credential row locks precede the action application lock. Ordinary GET observation and final action owner, role, Key revision, source/snapshot, CAS and one-claim checks remain; no timeout, retry, schema or grant expansion. New upgrade plans bind the complete strategy in their private target snapshot so older engines reject them before claim; genuine legacy image-only plans keep classic snapshots and original defaults.
